caption: The drawing depicts a single, centrally-placed goblet made of glass or a reflective material. The goblet has a wide, round base that gradually narrows upwards, forming a stem with ring-like decorative elements, and then flares outward again into a vase-shaped cup, which has a relatively small opening at the top. The goblet is colored in shades of grey, blue, and white, with highlights and reflections suggesting a glossy or metallic finish. The object is rendered against a plain beige background. A thin, rectangular outline frames the goblet, with the horizontal and vertical lines intersecting behind it. There are a few small, white marks and subtle stains on the background. The overall composition is symmetrical with the goblet centered within the rectangular border.
title: Sperm Oil Lamp
